request-prompt: Make the main video player larger and center it on the page, while adding a prominent 'up next' autoplay queue of related videos to keep me watching continuously.
goal: I prefer watching short-form videos to consume news and educational content because it is more visually engaging.
jobs: I want to watch the featured video about the weirdest exoplanets discovered by the Hubble Space Telescope to learn about space exploration.
I want to read the text summary of the exoplanet milestone to quickly understand the main facts of NASA's discovery.
I want to share this interesting video about bizarre space worlds with my friends or social media followers.
I want to browse other science, space, or trending videos to find more engaging content to watch.
I want to search for my local weather forecast using the search bar while visiting this website.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer watching short-form videos to consume news and educational content because it is more visually engaging.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer reading written articles over watching videos because I can skim the text to quickly find the key takeaways at my own pace.

preference-pairs.a: I am deeply interested in space, science, and nature, and actively seek out educational or informative content on these specific topics.
preference-pairs.b: I am a casual news consumer who prefers light, viral, or trending human-interest stories rather than scientific or highly educational topics.

preference-pairs.a: I enjoy exploring recommended or sponsored content grids at the bottom of pages to discover interesting external articles or products.
preference-pairs.b: I find recommended content grids and ads distracting and actively ignore them to focus strictly on the primary article or video I visited.

preference: I prefer watching short-form videos to consume news and educational content because it is more visually engaging.
